addons.name: Alleycat courier
addons.summary: Pick up and deliver fragile packages through Downtown Los Santos traffic against the clock.
addons.description: Random pickup and drop-off points in Downtown Los Santos, marked on the map with a GPS route; you choose your own line through traffic. Packages are fragile: hitting a car, a kerb or a wall, or falling, damages the one you carry, and at 0% it is lost. Heavy packages bring a storm and a headwind that GTBike V sends to your trainer as extra resistance; rain also lowers grip. The clock starts at the first pickup. Not available while a course is loaded; loading one ends the mission.

parameters.label: Packages
parameters.description: How many packages to pick up and deliver.

parameters.label: Time limit
parameters.description: Total time, counted from the first pickup.

parameters.label: Fragility
parameters.description: How much damage a hit does to the package.

parameters.label: Heavy packages
parameters.description: Chance that a package is heavy (storm and headwind while you carry it).

parameters.label: Storm with heavy packages
parameters.description: Thunderstorm in Downtown and rain elsewhere while a heavy package is carried. Rain lowers grip in GTBike V.

parameters.label: Headwind with heavy packages
parameters.description: Wind speed set against the rider while a heavy package is carried; 0 turns it off. GTBike V sends it to the trainer as resistance.

parameters.label: On-screen status
parameters.description: Package, integrity, time and distance as a subtitle in the game.
